merchant/30387.htm.text: Wharf Manager Clancy: Welcome! Are you here to board a ship? Ship traffic has increased a lot now that routes to Elmore are opened again. At first it was just cargo, but now we have enough interest to operate a passenger liner. It's nice to see all the activity again! Ah, a liner heading to the Tow…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30387-pk.htm.text: Wharf Manager Clancy: How'd you happen to commit a crime? Yeah. Tsk, tsk ... So many people have heard about you, I reckon no one will let you take their boat. Why don't you just turn yourself in and take your punishment?
